description: Narrow ramp-profile search to replace the RC28 profile rejected by the frozen CINDER 1.1.2 construction audit. Every candidate preserves the reference nose and full dynamic fixed-pivot mechanism; only the smooth tail geometry changes.
selection_rule: The original RC28 profile is a preflight rejection control and is never executed. Replacement candidates must first pass decode_reference_case / released fixed-pivot construction audit in the user's frozen Results environment; only accepted definitions are integrated on the unchanged 732 m final course.

competitors.label: Original RC28 rejection control
competitors.intent: Exact RC28 geometry from final_v2. It is retained only to confirm the frozen environment reproduces the construction-audit rejection; it is never integrated.

competitors.label: Ramp 22 deg, 7 mm blend
competitors.intent: Early reshaping with a milder endpoint and longer blend than RC28; seek a robust falling working-speed characteristic.
